{{stub}} '''Quality''' is a property of all equipment in ''[[Dungeon Defenders]]'', including [[weapons]], [[accessories]], [[armor]], and [[pets]]. It may refer to the item's base quality or tier which is usually the prefix in its name. A broader definition is, "the bias of how high something rolls within its possible range" (Moose). This depends on the [[Maps|map]]/[[Challenges|challenge]], [[Difficulties|difficulty]], game mode and the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]]/[[Ruthless Mode|Ruthless]]{{Version|redux}} toggle. ==Base Quality== An item's base quality or tier is a simple way to determine its overall strength and value. [[Armor]] may have an additional prefix that describes its [[Damage Resistance|damage resistances]]. All [[pets]] and most map-specific weapon rewards for completion do not have their quality listed in the name. ===Base Quality Value=== In the table below, "Level" shows the minimum level a hero must be to equip an item of that quality level, and "Multiplier" indicates the relative value and stats of equipment with that quality. *"Ultimate" weapons, armor, and pets may either require level 90 or 93. === Ultimate and Above Probabilities === On PC, any generated non-[[Accessories|accessory]] item initially calculated to be Ultimate (Level 90 requirement) has a chance to be any of the higher qualities instead. Furthermore in ''[[Redux]]'', an item that becomes Ultimate++ may turn into a Divine or, if armor, Void instead. Ultimates, and thus everything above, are significantly more common on [[Ascension]] than [[Nightmare]]. Void weapons can only be obtained through crafting at the [[Void Forge]]. Divine is the highest quality available for all other weapons. ====Quality Ascending Odds==== *''"Chance to Ascend" refers to going up one quality tier.'' {| class="article-table" !Quality !Chance to Ascend !Cumulative |- |Ultimate |40% (2:5) |40% (2:5) |- |Ultimate93 |33% (1:3) |13.333% (2:15) |- |Ultimate+ |20% (1:5) |2.667% (2:75) |- |Ultimate++ |35% (7:20)* |0.933% (~1:107)* |- |} *Redux only. Armor above Ultimate++ has an even 50/50 chance to become Divine or Void. ===='Overall Odds'==== *''Data taken from Discord user Scrub.'' {| class="article-table" ! rowspan="2" |Quality ! colspan="2" |General % of Ultimates |- !As a Percent !As a Radio |- |Ultimate |60% |3:5 |- |Ultimate93 |26.8% |~1:4 |- |Ultimate+ |10.56% |~1:10 |- |Ultimate++ |1.716% |~1:58 |- |'''Divine*''' |'''0.924%''' |'''~1:108''' |- |'''Divine''' |'''0.462%''' |'''~1:216''' |- |'''Void''' |'''0.462%''' |'''~1:216''' |} *If not armor, this is the Ultimate item's chance to be Divine. ==Quality Multiplier Explained (In-Depth)== This multiplier will affect the final stats of the armor. How? Well it's simple, every armor drop has a coefficient which is unlikely the armor type/range. Obviously a higher range will give higher coefficients, those coefficients are the base stats of the armor/weapon and then when the type is rolled will be multiplied with the multiplier. Remember that those coefficients are just random and given for the system. I guess they set a range of coefficients for every map to be multiplied depending the quality of the piece. E.g. If the coefficients are 5 / 10 / 8 / -1 and the weapon is Epic the final stats of that armor will be... 5(6.3) / 10(6.3) / 8 (6.3) / -1(6.3) = 31 ==Armor-Exclusive Attributes== ''Main Article: [[Armor]]'' ===Set Bonus Compatibility=== Wearing a full set of the same material type of armor (Leather, Mail, Chain, Plate or Pristine) yields a set bonus to the positive stats of every piece, based on its specific quality tier. The set must also be a combination of Cursed-Godly or Mythical and above pieces. Mixing the two groups '''does not''' make it set-bonus compatible. Teal inner borders and stat numbers indicate that armor set bonuses are active. ===Damage Reduction Quality=== Armor might have a second quality in its name which effects how many out of the four [[Damage Resistance|damage resistances]] it has and how many of them roll negative. As a base, all armor must have at least 1% reduction to generic damage, and around a net 0% elemental resistance/weakness. The damage reduction quality of an armor piece can offset this balance. {| border="1" cellpadding="5" style="border: 1px solid white" |- ! Name !! Multiplier !! Notes |- | Unlucky || -1000 || Unlucky armor frequently has 1 elemental weakness, or in some cases, 1 resistance and 2 weaknesses. |- | ''blank'' || 0 || Armor with this damage reduction quality has no second prefix. Such armor typically has either no elemental qualities, or 1 resistance balanced by 1 weakness. |- | Lucky || 1 || Lucky armor has either 1 elemental resistance, or 2 resistances and 1 weakness to balance. |- | Blessed || 2 || Blessed armor has 2 elemental resistances and no weakness. |- | Enchanted || 3 || The highest damage reduction quality, enchanted armor has resistances to all 3 elements. |} Enchanted armor has a higher negative threshold (1) than the others (0.93), making it almost always a superior choice. The '''Cursed''' armor quality is a normal, base quality, not a damage reduction quality. It's possible to find '''Cursed Unlucky''' armor, though it is not advisable to equip it, as such armor is usually worse than wearing no armor at all! == Stat Bonus Caps == The quality tier of an item affects how high each of its stat bonuses can be upgraded to. {| class="article-table" !Tier !Stat Cap !Stat Cap (w/ Armor Set Bonus) !Set Bonus |- |Cursed-Godly | rowspan="2" |360 |450 |25% |- |Mythical |468 |30% |- |Transcendent |420 |559 |~33% |- |Supreme |500 |680 |36% |- |Ultimate |600 |840 | rowspan="3" |40% |- |Ultimate+ |700 |980 |- |Ultimate++ |999 |1398* |- |'''Divine**''' | rowspan="2" |1099 | rowspan="2" |1593* | rowspan="2" |45% |- |'''Void**''' |} *A single stat-capping Ult++, Divine or Void armor piece is extremely rare. **Divine and Void are exclusive to ''[[Redux]]''. == Rerolling == In ''[[Dungeon Defenders Redux|Redux]]'', the stats of any Ultimate++, Divine or Void [[armor]] piece can be "rerolled," or recalculated, by spending 4 [[Void Crystal|Void Crystals]]. This replaces the item with one of the same (or "Cursed" 40% of the time) base quality. The material type (Leather, Mail, Chain, Plate or Pristine) and part (Helmet, Chest, Gloves or Boots) is chosen at random. == Pet Exceptions == A number of purely passive 'builder' pets never have a quality above Godly, but their hero level requirement can be higher than 70.
